caseNumber.title: Case Number
caseNumber.description: Reference number of the new (CREATED) or already existing (DUPLICATE) business enquiry. Blank otherwise. Never invent or change it.

city.title: City
city.description: City of the pincode. Filled only when the pincode is serviceable.

customerName.title: Customer Name
customerName.description: Full name the customer entered in the form. Use only to address the customer.

designation.title: Designation
designation.description: Designation the customer entered in the form.

district.title: District
district.description: District of the pincode. Filled only when the pincode is serviceable.

emailAddress.title: Email Address
emailAddress.description: Email address the customer entered in the form.

message.title: Message
message.description: The exact message to show the customer. Reply with this text as it is and never change the reference number in it.

mobileNumber.title: Mobile Number
mobileNumber.description: 10-digit mobile number the customer entered in the form.

organisationName.title: Organisation Name
organisationName.description: Organisation name the customer entered in the form.

pincode.title: Pincode
pincode.description: 6-digit pincode the customer entered in the form.

state.title: State
state.description: State of the pincode. Filled only when the pincode is serviceable.

status.title: Status
status.description: CREATED = the form registered a new business enquiry. DUPLICATE = a business enquiry already exists with the same mobile number and email. FORM_INCOMPLETE = the customer clicked the chat Submit before completing the form with its Submit Request button. ERROR = the request could not be processed.
